## Decision-history evaluation and revised recommendations

Independent adversarial review: the background reviewer checked these dispositions against frozen code 11d5994594fce53928a1d6f832b1deaa26e34160 and tracker 46168442ee634afe78703ed3f42b9964aba7fa75. It agreed with all six directions at medium-high or high confidence, while correcting the deterministic-floor version and rejecting the human-review framing after the operator clarified that Gerrit is an autonomous agentic process.

### 1. Escaped-defect metadata — REFINE

Prior decision and rationale: commonlaw-cinnamonic-joey rejected another mandatory create/close field because the required close-class rollout broke automation surfaces and because automated filers would stamp low-information constants. evadible-ambitious-canary therefore implemented optional, present-only detected_by capture at the shared creation seam: automation can set it without prompting, unknown values fail open, absence remains explicit, and history is not synthetically backfilled. big-mammalian-bronco and cloned-beryl-quokka delivered the program and metrics lens.

Observed outcome and correction: the current store has 648 bugs, 7 with the detected_by FIELD (agent 2, binding-drift-canary 2, heartbeat-canary 3), and 0 detected_by:* tags. The source audit queried tags, so its claim that no bug had metadata used the wrong representation. Coverage is still only 1.1%, so the broader observability conclusion remains valid, but the implementation did work before the audit cutoff.

Revised proposal: preserve zero-friction, fail-open creation. Expand automatic detected_by stamping at known automated-filer and agent-session boundaries, report missing explicitly, and measure post-rollout coverage by creation_channel. Aim near 100% for automated filers; do not prompt all reporters, require the field globally, or backfill unverifiable history unless inferred records are clearly marked.

### 2. Deterministic plan preflight — REFINE, build on the existing floor

Prior decision and rationale: elfin-floor-gouge shipped the initial deterministic layer; current code is P1-P11, not P1-P8. depleted-lethal-brownbear added blocking P10/P11 only after backtests established low false-positive rates; it explicitly rejected spec-by-example and riskiest-assumption blockers because they did not discriminate good from blocked plans. The floor blocks only sound mechanical conditions and leaves uncertain checks advisory/fail-open.

Cost/churn evidence: childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet found that incremental per-criterion re-review is unsafe: 37% of 894 revised-plan pairs blocked on a criterion absent from the first block, and skipping unchanged-looking criteria would miss real findings. It separately found 21% of full-LLM re-reviews ran on identical material, a quality-neutral target. The source audit's 49.0% first-pass rate and p90 of 8 attempts strengthen the case for further Pareto analysis, not for a second generic preflight framework.

Revised proposal: extend P1-P11 only for recurrent, mechanically decidable failure classes demonstrated in persisted review/completion data. Require offline replay against pass/block cohorts, an explicit false-positive ceiling, fail-open behavior when grounding is uncertain, and advisory rollout before promotion. Preserve semantic LLM review for architecture, failure modes, portability, tests, and tradeoffs.

### 3. Completion-failure classification — REFINE, derive before adding schema

Prior work and outcome: olivine-married-kodiakbear made FAIL sidecars durable; chief-sizeable-skua requires exhaustive unmet-criterion findings; cinnamoned-tzarist-kangaroo added ERROR; crumply-denim-pitbull preserves PASS criteria; earthen-flayed-baboon distinguishes insufficient evidence; beryl-orange-oropendola tallies survived step failures; paralyzed-sane-flyingfox derives gate economics; depressant-amethyst-wasp exposes the audit trail. The independent audit counted 351 failure sidecars with 682 already-structured findings carrying criterion, dimension, severity, detail, citations, and remediation.

Why the source proposal needs narrowing: the 72.3% completion first-pass rate mixes implementation defects, unmet ACs, missing proof, plan/scope gaps, environment/integration errors, and verifier defects. Treating all non-PASS outcomes as escaped code defects would be invalid.

Revised proposal: first classify historical first-non-PASS sidecars offline into code defect, unmet AC, missing test/evidence, plan/scope gap, environment/integration failure, and verifier/tool failure. Validate inter-rater/classifier agreement on a sample. Add durable reason codes only if the categories prove stable and cannot be derived reliably. Do not build a parallel telemetry channel.

### 4. Risk-tiered review — REFINE; defer hard enforcement

Prior decision and rationale: bugs remain exempt from claim-time plan review because RCA is not known when work begins. oblivious-flaky-squamata instead calibrated an actual-diff backstop: bug fixes over 150 non-test lines require current plan review; its historical corpus flagged exactly 13 adjudicated-substantive changes among 113 and no mechanical false positives. unrational-expansive-catfish and cosey-vinegarish-mouflon document the precision-first posture: deterministic/security findings may block; broad LLM dimensions remain advisory until calibrated.

New evidence and limitation: larger diffs, initial plan non-PASS, planned breadth, and sensitive surfaces are plausible prospective signals, but caused_by attribution is noisy and there is no reliable escaped-defect denominator. The user also clarified that this project has no routine human Gerrit review; therefore the audit's proposed non-author human-review requirement is inapplicable.

Revised proposal: pilot risk reporting without merge enforcement. Evaluate signals available before/during review: security, store, and concurrency surfaces; planned file impact; near-cap/high-complexity modules; plan-review failures; and actual diff breadth. For higher-risk changes, increase independent model/agent review, deterministic/property-based tests, and scrutiny of override paths. Measure defects/reverts by tier, blocking precision, override frequency, queue/cost impact, and CI-versus-LLM disagreement before choosing thresholds.

### 5. Proactive debt management — RECONSIDER; the proposed warning already shipped

Prior decisions and outcomes: cinderlike-lucky-akitainu first recorded an operator deferral, then documented worsening headroom evidence that justified a narrow exception. Gerrit change 1751 shipped the non-blocking warning at 720 LOC and targeted call-graph-seam extractions; it explicitly rejected draining the whole population. aberrant-sleeping-fanworms retained 27 of 73 janitor candidates after independent validity/impact review. ferreous-deadsmooth-dipper then upgraded the janitor to test prior decisions and reachable harm. civil-marlin-flare is the model disposition: its initial cross-clone-hazard premise was refuted, the work narrowed to byte-preserving consolidation of a real clone family, and a universal retry abstraction was rejected.

Revised proposal: remove "add a soft 720-LOC warning" from future work because it is complete. Do not adopt the source audit's arbitrary 35-to-under-20, 15-to-under-5, or duplication-under-3% quotas as standalone objectives. Prioritize debt only where near-cap size intersects complexity, churn, duplication, defects, or architectural centrality; remediate concrete clone families and existing call-graph seams. Verify metric health because the headroom indicator previously emitted a confident false zero.

### 6. Maintainership/reviewer breadth — HEAVILY REFINE for autonomous governance

Prior decisions and outcomes: breaded-ammonitic-elephant delivered the OSS v1.0 community front door; fat-leaflike-canary delivered outsider onboarding; nonsecular-arthritic-sidewinder validated the GitHub-to-Gerrit intake path end to end; drossy-renderable-butterfly and heedless-caloric-pikeperch audited and remediated OSS/CI hygiene. The project already has governance, DCO, release, security, support, onboarding, and two independent automated Gerrit votes. wrathful-preregal-blobfish documented a former "required-with-human-override" framing, but the operator's current authoritative clarification is that the contribution process is autonomous and contains no human review. disparaged-gratuitous-rooster provides signed provider/model/tier provenance for gate outputs. defiant-orthoclase-buck made force-close reasons durable in the same locked STATUS write.

Revised proposal: do not add mandatory human approval or reviewer rotation. Treat autonomous-assurance independence and operational continuity as the remaining governance problem: durably distinguish author agent/model from reviewer agent/model; monitor provider diversity, correlated failures, retry exhaustion, CI-versus-LLM disagreement, and force/override reasons; and test secondary recovery paths for critical credentials, providers, Gerrit/GitHub services, and maintainer/operator responsibilities. External contribution funnel metrics may still be useful, but they do not measure autonomous review independence.

### Material limits

- A true bug escape rate and detection-stage efficiency are still unavailable.
- Proposed risk tiers have not been prospectively validated.
- Author-model independence from reviewer models is not currently auditable from the examined records.
- Force/override frequency and adjudication quality were not quantified here, despite durable reason capture now existing.
- No incident/SLO evidence establishes that rapid delivery cadence causes integration failures.
- Complete governance files do not demonstrate operational succession or provider continuity.
